hero.title: Creating splendid structures since 2000
hero.subtitle: Led by Chairman & MD Mr. Prashant Lathia: 50+ projects and 2 million+ sq ft across Mumbai's western belt.

story.title: Our story
lines: Began as a civil contractor trusted by Mumbai's leading developers.
Built towers up to 35 floors for Kalpataru, Rustomjee, Lodha and Mayfair.
Today we develop our own homes in Mumbai, Igatpuri and Nashik.

pillars.title: Vision
pillars.text: To be the most trusted and efficient developer in the infrastructure sector.

pillars.title: Philosophy
pillars.text: Luxury is an outcome of who we are, with care for our communities and environment.

pillars.title: Values
pillars.text: Integrity, time-bound accuracy, room to grow and LEED standards.

leadership.name: Mr. Prashant Lathia
leadership.line: Chairman & Managing Director. Over 50 projects delivered under his leadership.
